name: April McClain Delaney
bio: a Representative from Maryland; born in Buhl, Twin Falls County, Idaho, May 28, 1964; graduated from Buhl High School, Buhl, Idaho, 1982; B.A., Northwestern University, Evanston, Ill., 1986; J.D., Georgetown University Law Center, Washington, D.C., 1989; lawyer, private practice; non-profit executive; deputy assistant secretary for communications and information, United States Department of Commerce, 2022-2023; elected as a Democrat to the One Hundred Nineteenth Congress (January 3, 2025-present).
